title: Generation of transgene-free human induced pluripotent stem cells from erythroblasts in feeder-free conditions
protocol: Pour 10 mL of Ficoll-Paque PLUS into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Pour 10 mL of freshly drawn blood into another 50 mL Falcon tube and add 10 mL of PBS.
Homogenize the sample carefully.
Layer the diluted blood sample on top of the Ficoll layer without mixing them.
Centrifuge at 750 g for 20 minutes at room temperature with brake off.
Remove as much plasma (upper yellow layer) as possible using a 10 mL pipette, leaving the PBMCs layer undisturbed.
Gently harvest the PBMC ring and transfer the cells into a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add 30 mL of RPMI to the harvested PBMCs.
Centrifuge at 550 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the PBMCs in 10 mL of RPMI.
Count the cells.
Centrifuge at 750 g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in FBS/DMSO (90:10) at a concentration of 10 million cells/mL.
Distribute the cells into cryotubes, with between 5 to 10 million cells per tube.
Freeze the cryotubes at -80°C.
Thaw 10 million frozen human PBMCs in PBS + FBS 20%.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 min at 300 g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells by performing up-and-downs with a pipette in 1.5 ml of erythroblast medium.
Transfer the cells into one well of a low-binding 24-well plate.
Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add 500 μl/well of erythroblast medium on day 1.
Gently resuspend the cells with a pipette to homogenize the culture.
Split the culture into two wells (1 ml/well).
Add another 500 μl of erythroblast medium per well.
Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Sort CD71+ cells by MACS on day 4.
Harvest all the cells and centrifuge for 5 min at 300 g at room temperature on day 4.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 240 μl of MACS buffer.
Add 60 μl of CD71 Miltenyi microbeads to the cell suspension.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Add 6 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 300 g at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 500 μL of MACS buffer.
Insert the MACS column into the MACS separator magnet.
Wash the column with 500 μL of MACS buffer.
Add 500 μL of CD71 labeled cells into the column.
Wash the column three times with 500 μL of MACS buffer each time.
Remove the MACS column from the separator magnet and place it in a 15 mL Falcon collection tube.
Add 1 mL of MACS buffer to the MACS column, then firmly apply the plunger onto the column to flush out the positive fraction.
Collect the flow through (CD71+ cells fraction).
Centrifuge the positive fraction for 5 minutes at 300 g.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of Erythroblast medium.
Transfer the cells into a new well of a low-binding 24-well plate.
Incubate cells at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Resuspend erythroblasts by gentle flushing on day 5.
Incubate cells at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Resuspend cells if confluence is high.
Split the resuspended cells into two wells (500 μL/well).
Add 1 mL/well of Erythroblast medium for each well.
If confluence is not high, carefully remove 500 μL of medium without shaking the plate.
Add 1 mL of Erythroblast medium to the remaining cells.
Resuspend the cells to distribute them evenly in the well.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2.
On day 8, repeat step 13.
Assess cell confluence and purity by flow cytometry on day 11.
Resuspend cells by up and down pipetting.
Count cells and label approximately 150,000 cells with anti-CD71-PE and anti-CD36-FITC antibodies using standard flow cytometry staining procedure.
Wash labeled cells.
Analyze cells by flow cytometry to assess purity of CD71/CD36 double positive cells.
Keep erythroblasts in culture if purity is lower than 90% and continue the culture up to day 15.
Coat 3 wells of a 6-well plate with Matrigel.
Perform electroporation of erythroblasts on day 11 with episomes for cell reprogramming.
Adjust the concentration of plasmids pCXLE-hOCT3/4-shp53-F, pCXLE-hSK, and pCXLE-hUL to 1 μg/μL.
Mix 2 μL of each plasmid together.
Prepare the nucleofection mix using 82 μL of nucleofection solution and 18 μL of supplement.
Resuspend and count the erythroblasts.
Collect 1 million erythroblasts and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 300 g at room temperature.
Completely remove the supernatant from the erythroblasts.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 100 μL of nucleofection mix.
Add 6 μL of plasmid mix to the resuspended cells.
Homogenize by up-and-down pipetting to avoid bubble formation.
Transfer the cell suspension into a sterile cuvette provided with the Nucleofector kit and close the cuvette.
Select the Nucleofector program T-016 for CD34+ cells.
Insert the cuvette into the Amaxa Nucleofector and start the T-016 program.
Add 500 μL of erythroblast medium to the cuvette after nucleofection.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Avoid repeated aspiration of the sample and bubble formation.
Use 500 μL of erythroblast medium to rinse the cuvette and add it to the cell suspension.
Add 5 mL of erythroblast medium and distribute 2 mL of cell suspension in each Matrigel-coated well of the 6-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C 5% CO2.
On day 13, carefully add 1 mL of erythroblast medium on the side of the well without removing medium from the plate to avoid disturbing cells.
Incubate at 37°C 5% CO2.
On day 14, carefully add 1 mL of ReproTeSR medium on the side of the well without removing medium from the plate to avoid disturbing cells.
Incubate at 37°C 5% CO2.
On day 16, repeat step of adding 1 mL of ReproTeSR medium on the side of the well without removing medium from the plate.
On day 17, remove all the medium and slowly add 2 mL of ReproTeSR medium.
Incubate at 37°C 5% CO2.
Coat one 35 mm dish with Matrigel for each clone to be picked.
Remove the Matrigel solution from the coated dish.
Add 2 mL of StemMACS iPS-Brew XF medium supplemented with Y-27632 (10 μM) to the coated dish.
Scrap the chosen hiPSC clone with a 200 μL micropipette and aspirate the clumps as they detach.
Transfer the clumps to a 35 mm dish.
Name the newly generated hiPSC line with a unique ID.
Wash the well containing the hiPSC clone three times with PBS.
Add 1 mL of StemMACS iPS-Brew XF medium to the washed well.
Remove the medium from individual clones the day following picking.
Add 2 mL of StemMACS iPS-Brew XF medium to each individual clone.
Repeat step 26 every day from Mondays to Thursdays.
Add 3.5 mL of StemMACS iPS-Brew XF medium on Fridays instead of 2 mL.
Do not change the medium during weekends.
Once cells reach about 80% confluence, passage them.
Remove the culture medium.
Wash with 1 mL of PBS without Mg2+ Ca2+.
Add 1 mL of ReLeSR solution and incubate for about 3–5 min.
Monitor detachment process under microscope.
Carefully remove ReLeSR solution from dish.
Add 1 mL of Complete StemMACS™ iPS-Brew medium to the cells.
Gently spill it on the cells twice.
This procedure results in detachment of hiPSCs and generates clumps of 100–200 μm.
Harvest the cells in a Falcon tube.
Complete the volume of Complete StemMACS™ iPS-Brew medium to seed at a ratio of 1:8 to 1:10 (2 mL of medium per dish).
Plate the cells in 35 mm dishes.
Transfer the 35 mm dishes to the incubator set at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Move the dishes left to right and back and forth in the incubator to ensure homogeneous distribution of clumps.
Change the medium the day after passage and routinely as specified.
Do not attempt to detach differentiated cells or colonies containing differentiated cells along with hiPSCs during harvesting.
Amplify cells for at least three weeks to stabilize the cell line and allow episome fading.
Harvest hiPSCs from one dish as described in step 28.
Centrifuge the entire clump suspension at 300 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL of Cryostor and divide them into four cryotubes, with 500 μL per tube.
Freeze the tubes at -80°C.
Transfer cells to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage after 3-7 days at -80°C.
Quickly thaw the cell suspension at 37°C without complete thawing of medium.
Add 0.5 mL of StemMACS™ iPS-Brew medium to the vial.
Centrifuge the cells at 5 min at 300 g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in 4 mL of StemMACS™ iPS-Brew medium supplemented with Y-27632 (10 μM).
Distribute 2 mL per 35 mm Matrigel-coated dish and incubate at 37°C.
Change the medium the next day and continue cell culture as described above.
Pass hiPSCs through quality controls prior to downstream use.
Ensure episome disappearance in hiPSCs.
Assess the karyotype of hiPSCs to ensure no abnormalities occurred during reprogramming.
Monitor full pluripotency by immunofluorescence staining for pluripotency markers (SOX2, OCT4, Tra-1-60).
Remove hiPSC medium from one 35 mm dish at 80% confluence.
Add 1 mL of accutase.
Incubate until the edges of the hiPSC colonies start retracting.
Remove accutase and add 2 mL of DMEM/F-12 medium supplemented with 20% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Carefully scrape the hiPSC colonies using a cell lifter, maintaining the cells as clumps.
Transfer the hiPSC clumps into one well of a low-binding 6-well plate.
Split the EBs into two wells of a low-binding 6-well plate the next day.
Add 1 mL of DMEM/F-12 + 20% FBS to each well after splitting.
Perform 2/3 medium change every 2–3 days for 8 days.
Plate the EBs on Matrigel on day 10 after EB formation.
Continue culture by changing the medium every 2–3 days.
Fix the cells with PFA 4% for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells 3 times with PBS.
Stain the EBs to assess the expression of Pax6, SMA, and AFP markers.
